name: APIVerveNeverHaveIEver
summary: Never Have I Ever generates random statements for the popular party game.
description:
Never Have I Ever generates random statements for the popular party game. Features 330+ unique prompts with per-API-key tracking to avoid repeats.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Never Have I Ever from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
